title: Implement deterministic Gate 0, fresh independent DP, and media evidence ports

root_cause_and_repair.root_cause: The retired A7 implementation still consumed the removed pre-v3 VEC segment model and duplicate service-side Gate0Result, hashed free-text capability summaries, generated ReviewPacket identities outside IdFactory, allowed unbounded revision routing, and contained a visual-verification builder that always wrote passed=true. Its registered fixture also constructed removed v2 Draft fields, so most checks failed before exercising the dual-loop boundary.
root_cause_and_repair.repair: Gate 0 now emits only the A1-frozen DeterministicGateResult and revalidates canonical v3 schema, complete VEC digest, machine IDs, per-shot local ticks, N+1 boundaries, bidirectional typed bindings, the sole ProjectionAST identity, compiled prompt budgets, safety boundaries, and the TEXT_VALIDATED claim ceiling. ReviewPacket contains only approved opaque references and exact artifact IDs. Local IdFactory creates packet, fresh-session, DP result, RevisionRequest, media-run, frame-plan, media-evidence, and visual-verification identities. A fresh DP context is recomputed from the exact packet and attempt ordinal, rejects history or forbidden inputs as DP_INPUT_BLOCKED, and may only submit a bounded Draft that local code converts to canonical RevisionRequest artifacts. RevisionRouter can only return bounded creative fields to the Director Draft stage, deterministically recompile a projection, or reject. Media and approval ports return non-authoritative Draft DTOs; only fail-closed no-op adapters exist in A7 and no external media or approval was started.
rejected_shortcuts: No compatibility aliases or restored v2 segment, projection, Gate0Result, or free-text capability surfaces were added.
No DP output may contain a replacement VEC, canonical ID, hash, tick, projection, or out-of-packet evidence reference.
No revision request directly mutates a VEC or ProjectionAST; creative changes return to an allowlisted Director Draft path.
No text-only path defaults or promotes visual verification to passed.
No external renderer, verifier, approval adapter, production switch, or v4 code path was activated or modified.
No A8 or later-package path and no unrelated user workspace change was modified or staged.

checks.name: deterministic_gate_zero
checks.result: Exact canonical Gate result; v3 digest, ID, tick, N+1 boundary, typed binding, single projection, prompt budget, safety, and claim-ceiling checks are deterministic and fail closed.

checks.name: fresh_independent_dp_packet
checks.result: ReviewPacket carries only approved opaque references and exact canonical artifact bindings; packet and session IDs are locally recomputed and history/forbidden inputs emit DP_INPUT_BLOCKED.

checks.name: dp_only_emits_bounded_revision_request
checks.result: The DP Draft contains neither persistent IDs nor replacement authority; local code resolves only in-packet evidence and creates canonical bounded RevisionRequest and review-result artifacts.

checks.name: bounded_revision_router
checks.result: Field paths, facts, targets, failure types, and budget are allowlisted; routes are Director Draft revision, deterministic projection recompile, or rejection, never VEC mutation.

checks.name: text_cannot_claim_visual_acceptance
checks.result: Text status stops at TEXT_VALIDATED; visual verification requires explicit verifier output bound to canonical media evidence, and approval remains an inactive A10 human Draft port.

checks.name: media_outcome_attribution
checks.result: Gate, media-render, and media-verifier failures produce machine-readable canonical OutcomeAttribution values with their exact causal layer.

checks.name: canonical_projection_and_evidence_consumption
checks.result: Gate and DP consume the exact shared ProjectionAST identity, canonical manifests, canonical Gate result, and SourceRef-bound evidence without a second authority.

checks.name: external_media_not_started
checks.result: A7 exposes only fail-closed NoopMediaRenderer and NoopMediaVerifier adapters; no approval adapter, media run, frame evidence, or external call was started.
